en: Achoo! What do we say when we sneeze?
Our beloved Prophet, Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam, taught us:
When you sneeze, say: Alhamdulillah! All praise is for Allah.
When your friend hears it, they say: Yarhamukallah! May Allah have mercy on you.
Then you answer: Yahdikumullah wa yuslih balakum.
It means: May Allah guide you, and make things good for you.
One little sneeze, and three beautiful duas!
Who will you teach this to today?
